description: 视觉实现参考配置；当前未被应用或预览运行时读取。所有尺寸为参考桌面的像素值。

flowers.coordinates: Each root is local to the flower bounds; y increases downward.
flowers.slotSemantics: Visual slot IDs are placement placeholders only. They do not assign, combine, reorder or replace any DDL identity or lifecycle state.

slots.direction: upright with a slight natural bend

placementConstraints: The three roots have unequal spacing; retain separate stems and individually readable silhouettes.
Layout scale and lean never choose a flower stage or change a stage timestamp.
Keep each flower head attached at its own calyx through all six source poses.
Do not move or rescale the flower layer when the grape layer appears or hides.
Use existing flower art and preserve berry petals, ivory edges, plum folds and gold centers.

grapeLayer.verticalAdjustment: Raise the entire grape layer by 72 reference pixels without changing either layer's size or flower placement; assembled displayed bounds are 400 by 364 pixels.
grapeLayer.visibility: Follow the existing presentation state only.
composition: Shorten the horizontal support and vary grape hanging positions rather than forming one straight upper band.
Use a slender support near the right edge and a sparse descending vine to bridge the upper fruit and lower plants.
Allow irregular protruding leaves and open gaps; avoid a rectangular enclosure or an opaque silhouette.
Retain the existing purple, green and gold fruit appearance and all existing maturity and falling behavior.

decoration.grassTreatment: Small separated blades emerging at the screen bottom; transparent gaps remain between roots.
decoration.detailTreatment: Reduce wood grain, leaf veins and repeated grass highlights. Preserve flower and fruit detail.
decoration.paletteNote: Suggested secondary-element colors only; do not recolor flower heads or fruit.

outline.lightEdgePlacement: Sparse selected edges only where needed against dark backgrounds.

sourcePreservation.implementationBoundary: Apply only rendering transforms, artwork simplification, local palette treatment and layer visibility. This specification does not create or claim runtime DDL, picking or maturity capabilities absent from an existing host.
sourcePreservation.coordinateConstraint: If a host scales or moves fruit, transform its existing falling origin and hit target with the same visual-to-screen transform; do not alter mechanism timing or identity.
